outcome: types of symptoms reported by pregnant women
cohort: The study participants were 36,910 pregnant patients who completed an online survey between January 1, 2019, and June 30, 2022.
finding: The COVID-19 pandemic significantly increased pregnant women's utilization of virtual triage, shifting reported symptoms towards acute respiratory infections.
cross-section timing: Data was collected from January 1, 2019, to June 30, 2022, and segmented into six-month periods for analysis.
